llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The external HuDy MCP endpoint and custom holiday data flow are visible in setup and tool descriptions; clearer privacy wording would help users, but the behavior is coherent with the stated integration and not enough for Review.
[VirusTotal-pending] expected: VirusTotal has no completed negative result, and the only artifact is non-executable markdown, so this telemetry does not change the verdict.
llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use hudy.co.kr and are comfortable sending queried dates and custom holiday names to that service. Keep HUDY_API_KEY private, and confirm the exact date/name before allowing create, update, or delete actions because those records can affect later business-day calculations and calendar sync.
llm.summary: This is a straightforward HuDy MCP setup guide for Korean holiday and business-day tools, with expected API-key use and disclosed custom holiday management.
